Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Seno Quoro: 25-year-old man, 169 cm (medium), conditioned athletic construction with functional tone but no ripped definition, skin value band-1-lightest. Face: square compact face; full cheeks and sharply defined brows; flat broad nose, defined cupid's bow; subtle age lines. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: dark-brown, bob-pageboy, deliberate accent: hidden undercut. Wardrobe: draped-robe, specifically a draped robe whose belting and openings keep the body construction legible; a divided hem and broad folded collar; bounded palette lilac-smoke. Visible personal details: a dense freckle field; a tiny nose stud; a patterned collar insert. Make unusual but bounded color blocking the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: visible mending treated as prideful craft. Color treatment: balances one confident color field against quiet neutrals. Pose cue: chin remains level while one hand lightly checks a cuff seam. Include a tiny cloth-wrapped notebook only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance.
